local vtext = "HELLO"
local vkey = "K"
local vresult = ""
local alpha = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
local fullKey = vkey
for (i: 1 .. vtext.textLen() - 1) {
  fullKey = fullKey _ vtext.segment(i, 1)
}
for (i: 1 .. vtext.textLen()) {
  local p = alpha.indexOf(vtext.segment(i, 1)) - 1
  local k = alpha.indexOf(fullKey.segment(i, 1)) - 1
  vresult = vresult _ alpha.segment((p + k) % 26 + 1, 1)
}
println(vresult)

3591.answer:
func textToColor(s) = {
  local r = 0
  local g = 0
  local b = 0
  for (i: 1 .. s.textLen()) {
    local code = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789".indexOf(s.segment(i,1))
    r = (r + code * i) % 256
    g = (g + if (i % 2 == 0) code else 256 - code) % 256
  }
  b = s.textLen() * 17 % 256
  makeColor([r, g, b])
}
println(textToColor("hello"))
println(textToColor("world"))

3631.answer:
local saWord = "abbc"
local saLen = saWord.textLen()
local saStates = [{}]
local saLast = 1
local saSize = 1
for (ci: 1 .. saLen) {
  local ch = saWord.segment(ci, 1)
  local cur = saSize + 1
  saStates.add({})
  saSize = saSize + 1
  local p = saLast
  while (p != 0 && !saStates[p].containsKey(ch)) {
    saStates[p].set(ch, cur)
    p = saStates[p].get("link", 0)
  }
  saLast = cur
}
println("States: " _ saStates.listLen())
